answer: An agent economy can bind each identity to a slashable stake: before any vote or task counts, an agent locks collateral, and random audits verify that the identity has a single controller. A forged identity that fails an audit forfeits its whole bond. To field N Sybils, an attacker must lock N separate bonds, and each detected fake burns one bond, so expected cost N * stake * audit rate outruns any reward. The reef of clone accounts never tastes the nectar of payouts, and counterfeit jade is exposed and slashed.
